subject: Gerudo Training Grounds
text: Defeating the enemies in the first room to the left yields the first small key.

evidence.quote: Take the door to the left.  Kill the enemies and get the key (#1), then go through the next door.

subject: Gerudo Training Grounds
text: Using the Lens of Truth reveals an invisible chest containing the second small key after killing the enemies.

evidence.quote: Kill the enemies, then use the Lens of Truth to spot an invisible chest and open it for the key (#2).

subject: Gerudo Training Grounds
text: Shooting the statue eyes from the rotating platform allows Link to hookshot to the chest containing the third small key.

evidence.quote: Now drop down in the next room, and shoot the statue eyes from the rotating platform.  Hookshot to the chest and get the key (#3).

subject: Gerudo Training Grounds
text: Playing the Scarecrow's Song allows Link to hookshot up to the top ledge to reach the room with the fourth small key.

evidence.quote: Now, play the Scarecrow's Song to hookshot back up to the top ledge, and go through the newly unlocked door.  Get the key (#4), then go back to the previous room

subject: Gerudo Training Grounds
text: Pounding the totem poles with the Megaton Hammer reveals a switch that removes flames from the chest holding the fifth small key.

evidence.quote: Pound the totem poles with the Megaton Hammer to find a switch that deflames the chest that holds the key (#5).

subject: Gerudo Training Grounds
text: Behind a totem pole is a golden eye that unlocks doors when shot.

evidence.quote: Behind another pole is a golden eye- shoot it to unlock the doors, then go through the door leading to the next area.

subject: Gerudo Training Grounds
text: Using the Song of Time, Iron Boots, and Longshot in the underwater room allows Link to collect silver rupees and open a chest for the sixth small key.

evidence.quote: Play the Song of Time, equip the Iron Boots and drop down into the water, then use the Longshot to collect the silver rupees.  Swim up and get the key (#6) from the chest

subject: Gerudo Training Grounds
text: Playing the Song of Time on one of the center platforms creates stepping blocks leading to the seventh small key.

evidence.quote: Hop to one of the center platforms and play the Song of Time creating stepping blocks to key (#7).

subject: Gerudo Training Grounds
text: Entering the room opposite the Hookshot target and killing the enemies rewards the eighth small key.

evidence.quote: Now enter the room opposite the one with the Hookshot target.  Kill the enemies here and get key (#8).

subject: Gerudo Training Grounds
text: In the key maze, using the Lens of Truth reveals a passage in the ceiling with a chest containing another key.

evidence.quote: Go through the first locked door to the left, then use the Lens of Truth to spot a passage in the ceiling; climb up and get the key from the chest there.

subject: Gerudo Training Grounds
text: Unlocking all the doors in the key maze leads to a big chest containing the Ice Arrows.

evidence.quote: Then, just go through all the locked doors in this room and get the Ice Arrows from the big chest at the end.

subject: Zora's Fountain
text: Lifting the boulder near the Great Fairy cavern entrance with the Silver Gauntlets reveals a hole with the final Gold Skulltula on the wall at the top.

evidence.quote: Go all the way back to Zora's Fountain, then go to the south end of it where the entrance to the Great Fairy cavern is.  Lift up the boulder here with the Silver Gauntlets and drop inside the hole.  Go up the slope and up the ladder, and the final Gold Skulltula is on the wall at the top, to the left.

subject: House of Skulltula
text: Returning to the House of Skulltula after getting all 100 Skulltula tokens yields infinite rupees from the man inside.

evidence.quote: After you get all 100 Skulltula tokens, you can go back to the House of Skulltula and get infinite rupees from the man inside.

subject: Temple of Time
text: Entering the Temple of Time as Adult Link after obtaining all medallions triggers Zelda giving Link the Light Arrows before she is captured.

evidence.quote: Enter the Temple of Time as Adult Link after you have all the medallions. Zelda gives you the final arrow upgrade, but gets captured in the process.

subject: Ganondorf
text: Ganondorf is defeated by deflecting energy balls back at him from the perimeter, stunning him with a Light Arrow, and slashing him with the sword.

evidence.quote: To defeat him, stand on the perimeter of the room, and deflect his energy balls back at him until he gets hit.  Then, fire a Light Arrow at him, and jump over and slice him up with your sword.

subject: Ganondorf
text: When Ganondorf charges a gigantic orb as the room darkens, release a powered-up spin attack as the orb is launched.

evidence.quote: If he starts to charge a gigantic orb and the room darkens, power up your spin attack and unleash it when the orb is launched at you.

subject: Shadow Barrier
text: A chest on the right side of the Shadow Barrier room contains the Golden Gauntlets.

evidence.quote: Go back across, shoot the torch again with a Fire Arrow, then jump across the ice platforms to the right and step on the switch there....Get the Golden Gauntlets from the chest.

subject: Great Fairy
text: Lifting the giant pillar outside Ganon's Castle with the Golden Gauntlets reveals a Great Fairy cave that grants Double Defense.

evidence.quote: With the Golden Gauntlets, exit Ganon's Castle, then go under the big arch to the left and go down the valley.  Lift up the giant pillar, then go inside the cave and receive the Double Defense from the Great Fairy.

subject: Forest Barrier
text: Using Din's Fire on the four center torches and a Fire Arrow on the torch above the door unlocks the door in the Forest Barrier.

evidence.quote: Use Din's Fire to light the four center torches and a Fire Arrow on the torch above the door, then go through the door.

subject: Water Barrier
text: The Water Barrier requires blue fire to melt red ice, along with pushing blocks into a hole and beneath the red ice ledge.

evidence.quote: Catch some blue fire in a couple bottles, kill the enemies, drop some blue fire on the red ice, and go through the door....Push the far block into the hole, then push the other block below the ledge with the red ice.

subject: Light Barrier
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce symbol inside the Light Barrier room produces a key.

evidence.quote: Play Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce symbol to get the key, and go through.

subject: Spirit Barrier
text: Hitting the crystal behind the cage grants Bombchus, which must be launched over the cage to strike the far crystal.

evidence.quote: Hit the crystal behind the cage to get Bombchus, then lay a Bombchu so it goes over the cage and hits the far crystal, and go through the next door.

subject: Spirit Barrier
text: Shooting the ceiling with a Fire Arrow allows light to be reflected onto the sun symbols using the Mirror Shield to unlock the door.

evidence.quote: Shoot the ceiling with a Fire Arrow and reflect the light on the sun symbols with the Mirror Shield to unlock the next door.

subject: Central Tower
text: Link obtains the Boss Key in the central tower after killing the Stalfos.

evidence.quote: Make your way up the tower, killing the enemies, then get the Boss Key after killing the Stalfos.

subject: Ganon
text: Ganon is stunned by shooting his head with a Light Arrow or rolling between his legs, after which his tail can be damaged with the Megaton Hammer, Biggoron's Sword, or Master Sword.

evidence.quote: To damage Ganon, shoot its head with a Light Arrow to stun it- or simply roll under its legs- and pound the tail with the Megaton Hammer or slice it with the Biggoron's Sword....Now, battle it the same way as before, but use the Master Sword to damage it this time.
